_comment: Match rules for the sales_contract entity type.
Deliberately kept separate from the 'contract' entity type (mysql-rds
Contracts table) — the two systems share no common key, so merging them
would require a fuzzy name/account match that risks silently combining
unrelated records. Revisit if a real shared identifier is established.
Single source with a stable system-assigned primary key (sales_contract_id)
— deterministic exact matching on that key is sufficient.

rules._comment: Rule 1 — Deterministic: identical sales_contract_id = same contract.
